entities.name: Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Lanciano-Ortona
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Archdiocese of Lanciano-Ortona is a Latin Church diocese of the Catholic Church that has existed under this name since 1986. Since 1982, it has been a suffragan of the Archdiocese of Chieti-Vasto.
